The project is 97 days past its contract completion date, and the P6 update now forecasts initial handover on 16-Nov-2026. This week's P6 update (data date 10-Nov-2026) was rescheduled. Initial handover moves from 02-Nov to 16-Nov-2026, 103 days after the contract date of 05-Aug-2026, with −82.5 to −87 days of float on the 21 open activities. The weekly report still gives 05-Aug-2026 as the forecast completion. Construction is unchanged at 99.9% and its four open items are still at 0%; handing over rose to 53.6%, and testing and commissioning stays at 87.5%. The four issues reopened last week are still open.

Data notes

  • Physical % complete is taken from the Progress sheet of the weekly report (earned vs budgeted man-hours). The "Actual %" column in the P6 PDF layouts and the earned-value cells of the weekly report are cost-based, so they are not used.
  • This week's gain is the difference between the earned man-hours of the 10-Nov-2026 report (25,000) and the 03-Nov-2026 report (24,887); the previous-week columns of the 10-Nov report agree. All 113 man-hours are in handing over. Quantities this week are not available.
  • Dates disagree inside the weekly report: the General Information sheet gives site handover 06-May-2026 and completion 05-Aug-2026 (as does the P6 baseline), while the Milestones sheet gives award 16-Apr-2026, handover 30-Apr-2026 and completion 30-Aug-2026. The lower table of the Milestones sheet belongs to another fence project (SUD1-05-015).
  • The weekly report still forecasts completion on 05-Aug-2026 with zero variance, although that date has passed; P6 forecasts 16-Nov-2026.
  • The P6 update was rescheduled to a data date of 10-Nov-2026 (last week's file kept 27-Oct-2026). Seven close-out activities moved to exactly 88% this week (spares inspection and warranties from 35%, training from 20–24%), while the four open construction items stay at 0% and are each given less than half a day on 11-Nov-2026.
  • The FIR summary for 04–10 Nov-2026 records inspections of chain-link fence posts and accessories (stations 5+200 to 6+100 and 0+000 to 0+200) and of 46 landscape floodlights (29 + 17), while P6 still shows the lighting fixtures final fix at 0%. The chain-link gate inspections of 01-Nov-2026 no longer carry quantities. The 2-week look-ahead PDF shows the four open construction activities with a high "Actual %", which is cost-based; the XER gives them 0% physical.
  • In the P6 update, the Construction and Project Finish milestones are marked complete on 16-Sep-2026 while 21 activities are still in progress. Actual dates start on 13-Jul-2026 (Project Start), two months after handover; the electrical gate barrier shows an actual start of 12-Apr-2026, before the contract award.

  • The weekly report's Procurement sheet carries another project's code and has delivery data for only a few minor items. The separate Procurement Tracking Sheet uploaded this week is dated 27-Oct-2026 and gives only P6 activity percentages, without quantities; the procurement section uses it.
  • The invoice log shows a revised contract value of 21,100,000, an estimate at completion of 20,900,000 and potential changes of 200,000, against 16,500,001.96 and 0 in the General Information and Weekly Progress Report sheets.
  • The project stage is still "Mobilization" in the weekly report, and the MODON PM field is empty; the PM's name is taken from the HSE inspection sheet. The quality checklist names the contractor (HMA) as the consultant.
